display_information.name: ThreadTone
display_information.description: Rewrite your Slack replies so they match the tone and topic of the thread.
display_information.long_description: ThreadTone reads the conversation in a Slack thread, detects the tone (formal, casual, urgent, supportive, technical) and the topics being discussed, then rewrites your draft reply to fit. Use the message shortcut on any message, or run /threadtone. Works great in Slack for Mac.

shortcuts.name: Rewrite for thread
shortcuts.description: Rewrite a reply to match this thread's tone and topic

slash_commands.description: Rewrite a draft to match a thread's tone and topic
